subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'upgraded'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the concerned line is that throughout the world many women recognised their potential and enhanced their skills to prove they are equally powerful as any other gender.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word is 'upgraded'. 
 
• 'Upgraded' means 'to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or change it for something newer or of a better standard.'
 
• Example:
 
 
• *​Mohit has **upgraded** his computer from windows 10 to windows 11 recently.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Correct Sentence:__ *They have made themselves powerful and **__upgraded__** their skills.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
